title: Stone for {settlement}
Find us a quarry
summary: {settlement} has no {site} of its own. {giver} wants one found, {distance} from the town.
offer: We buy every stone we build with, and it costs us dear. Find a good rock face near the town — {distance} out — and we will open our own quarry.
complete: That will do very well. We open it this season.
